semiconductor_relevance: High — WoNik Semicon specializes in manufacturing quartz technology products and spare parts for semiconductor equipment, making it a relevant supplier in the semiconductor industry.
summary: WoNik Semicon CO.LTD. manufactures and researches semiconductor quartz technology products, focusing on high-quality consumable spare parts for semiconductor equipment. The company has a comprehensive inventory of standard machine spare parts and has recently expanded its manufacturing capabilities to meet growing demand.
capabilities: Production of ceramic arms for semiconductor equipment
Supply of quartz boats and high-temperature furnace tubes
On-demand supply of over 4,160 standard spare parts
technical_expertise: Spare parts logistics and inventory management

regional_presence.China: The company has established a new factory in China, enhancing its production capacity and supply chain capabilities.
